The '''INT-4 Interceptor'''<ref name="KMR" /> was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought by the Empire against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Offscreen" /> The short-range flyer was operated by a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and could be carried within the body of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. An enclosed vehicle, the INT-4 Interceptor had a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], landing skids,<ref name="KMR" /> and stabilizer wings. The Empire used the INT-4 Interceptor on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="Offscreen" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The INT-4 Interceptor was was created in [[1982]] for [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]]. The packaging described the craft as going on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission to find a Rebel base, and also pictured the INT-4 Interceptor as being operated by a [[Vehicle Command Crewer]].<ref name="KMR" /> On [[November 12]], [[1983]],<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> a [[Unidentified Centrality starfighter|similar vehicle]] appeared on the [[:File:Starcave_of_ThonBoka_Cover.jpg|cover]] of the novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''. However, that [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] illustration was based on Kenner's [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|Scout Walker]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] rather than the INT-4 Interceptor's design.<ref name="Offscreen" />
